input.title: Two Future Payments
input.request: I can see two future payments of £34.80 to Northmere Heating. Please check whether they are duplicates and remove the duplicate.

events.text: Two future payment lines of £34.80 to Northmere Heating are shown. Their relationship has not been established.
After completing H&V's identity checks, I asked you to escalate this and remove the duplicate. I do not know which line is the duplicate.
I am checking the type and internal reference of each instruction behind the two future lines. I have not cancelled either instruction.

summary: Mara Ellison, a verified caller, asked the desk to check two future £34.80 payments to Northmere Heating and remove whichever is a duplicate; she doesn't know which line it is. The desk classed this as a standing-order instruction, marked the payment system as asked with its answer not yet in, and closed the case in WAITING. The agent's later attempts to query the payment system again and to escalate were both refused because the case was no longer in the TRIAGED state, so no comparison was made and nothing was cancelled or changed. The record doesn't show anyone assigned to follow up, so whether either payment is a duplicate is still unresolved and needs a person to review.
